annotations.title: EU Green Taxonomy Alignment & TSC Checker

description:
[Deterministic EU Green Taxonomy alignment auditor. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits economic activities by NACE Rev. 2 code against Regulation (EU) 2020/852 Technical Screening Criteria (TSC), Do No Significant Harm (DNSH) rules, and Minimum Social Safeguards (MSS), calculating aligned Turnover, CapEx, and OpEx percentages.
Usage: Use this tool to verify taxonomy eligibility, taxonomy alignment, and sustainable finance disclosure metrics (SFDR Art. 8/9).
Returns: JSON object with { naceCode: string, isTaxonomyEligible: boolean, technicalScreeningCriteria: object, isTaxonomyAligned: boolean, financialKpiAlignment: object, reportingStandard: string }.

capexTurnoverEur.description: Financial KPI expenditure figures for alignment percentage calculation

eligibleCapexEur.description: CapEx associated with taxonomy-eligible activities in EUR

eligibleTurnoverEur.description: Turnover associated with taxonomy-eligible activities in EUR

totalCapexEur.description: Total annual capital expenditure in EUR

totalTurnoverEur.description: Total annual corporate turnover in EUR

dnshCriteriaMet.description: Whether activity complies with Do No Significant Harm (DNSH) across other 5 environmental objectives

lifecycleGhgIntensityGCo2ePerKwhOrUnit.description: Lifecycle GHG emissions intensity for Technical Screening Criteria verification

minimumSocialSafeguardsCompliant.description: Whether company complies with OECD Guidelines and UN Guiding Principles

naceCode.description: NACE Rev. 2 economic activity classification code (e.g. D35.11, C23.51, F41.20)
